acceptanceInventory.skipReason: Six Layout Instability API / CLS checks per Firefox and WebKit; no layout or accessibility cases suppressed.

browserRuns.name: complete-initial
browserRuns.scope: Complete 2049-case inventory before the last legal, contact, footer and native-playback corrections.

browserRuns.name: affected-follow-up
browserRuns.scope: 414 cases against a fresh production candidate; precedes the final semantic pointer targets and corrected observation window.

browserRuns.name: final-native-motion
browserRuns.scope: Final pointer targets, complete native lifecycle, reduced motion and motion-chunk fallback on the final production source snapshot. Corrected moving observation window is 3100 ms; assertions unchanged.

relocation.note: 72 cases in each isolated build; captured before native playback changes, which do not modify routing or configuration.

limitations: Not a single clean full-suite execution on the final source; full-run failures and their targeted resolutions are preserved.
Browser emulation and automated accessibility checks do not establish every-device or complete WCAG approval.

resolvedInitialFailures.cause: Two final Traditional Chinese legal revisions were compared with an earlier frozen build.
resolvedInitialFailures.resolution: All legal-localization cases pass on the fresh affected candidate in all three engines.

resolvedInitialFailures.cause: Footer action moved between pointer events while the lazy initial route committed.
resolvedInitialFailures.resolution: Footer waits for the normal/error route; delayed-route and Cookie Preferences cases pass in all three engines.

resolvedInitialFailures.cause: A 2100 ms moving observation could fit inside the longest 2600 ms reading phase.
resolvedInitialFailures.resolution: Use a 3100 ms observation, keeping all movement/visibility/phase assertions and 2100 ms resting observation. Final suite passes in all three engines.

resolvedInitialFailures.cause: WebKit API expansion sampling captured only seven/eight distinct progress levels during a concurrent full run. Trace supports scheduler pressure but cannot establish its sole cause.
resolvedInitialFailures.resolution: Both unchanged API progress assertions pass in the fresh affected run and in the final single-worker run.

publicationAtPackaging.note: Local validation does not certify a GitHub write, workflow completion or Pages publication.
